format_adaptations.reason: Coordinator's explicit WP-005 decision authorizes only this output correction. The pinned English format and L10n.swift comparison(_ p1: Int, _ p2: Any), as called by ComparisonRowView with roundTripMs, unambiguously require an integer first argument. Retain the original Chinese copy, raw format, exact blob/value fingerprints and correction ID in provenance. This is not a Swift edit, retranslation, global coercion or permission to repair other copy.

locale_notes.en: Unqualified values are the complete English fallback; missing translations are omitted, never fabricated.
locale_notes.pt: Portugal translation (TRANSLATIONS.md). Per-app choice pt-PT; values-pt retains Apple's language-wide pt fallback, including pt-BR. Runtime plural/number rules use the requested configuration locale.
locale_notes.zh-Hans: Explicit Simplified Chinese script qualifier values-b+zh+Hans, not generic/traditional zh.

locale_record_schema.english_fallback: Absent means false; true is recorded only for an actual missing translation.
locale_record_schema.flat_fallback_input: Optional index of the separate strings fallback for a plural.
locale_record_schema.format_adaptation: Absent means no correction; otherwise the exact declared correction ID.
locale_record_schema.quantities: Present for plurals only, in canonical quantity order.
locale_record_schema.source_input: Zero-based index into inputs; exact path/blob/SHA256 are never repeated or omitted.
